u0: Initial carrying phase: the agent starts with the purple box in hand and the first fall has not happened yet. Move toward the exit while carrying the box; if the box slips out, switch immediately to recovering it, and if the exit is reached, the episode ends successfully.
u1: First-fall recovery window: the box has just slipped out of the agent's hands and lies in the cell it now faces, so holding_box is false. Pick it up on this very next step for the recovery bonus, then resume heading to the exit; if the immediate pickup is missed, continue toward the exit and recover the box later if useful.
u2: After the first fall has been handled: the immediate pickup either succeeded, so the box is back in hand, or it was missed, leaving the box on the floor. Continue toward the exit; recover the box if empty-handed, and if carrying it, stay ready for another fall, which starts a new immediate-recovery window. Reaching the exit ends the episode.
u3: Another-fall recovery window: a new fall has just occurred after the earlier recovery phase, the box is on the floor in front of the agent, and holding_box is false. Try to pick it up on the very next move for the recovery bonus; afterward continue toward the exit. If the immediate pickup is missed, the box can still be reacquired later, and reaching the exit ends the episode.
u4: Post-fall phase after the second tracked fall: the immediate pickup opportunity has been resolved, so the box is either back in hand or still on the floor. No further fall-recovery cycle is tracked here; focus on reaching the exit, optionally reacquiring the box on the way, since stepping onto the exit terminates the episode successfully.
u5: Terminal success: the agent has reached the exit and the episode ends immediately. No further movement, toggle, or box recovery is needed.
